title: Subscription limits
problem_unreachable: The gateway can't be reached; these are its last numbers
problem_rejected: The gateway turned the key away; update it in Admin → Usage sources. These are its last numbers
problem_failed: Couldn't read the gateway; these are its last numbers
problem_error: The gateway couldn't read this account just now; these are the numbers it had stored
connect_hint_claude: No usage data yet; ask the assistant to wire up statusLine or a gateway source
connect_hint_agy: The CLI reports no quota percentage locally; ask the assistant to connect a pool gateway if used
connect_hint_other: No usage data yet; ask the assistant to connect its gateway or a local usage script
connect_prompt_claude: Please help me connect Claude Code ({id}) usage to Persona's sidebar usage strip: check my current Claude setup, wire up a statusLine wrapper writing to usage/claude.json in Persona's data directory if it's a direct subscription (preserving any existing statusLine), or help connect its gateway usage source / quota extension.
connect_prompt_agy: Please check whether Antigravity ({id}) usage on this computer can be connected to Persona's sidebar usage strip (for example through Persona's generic usage source or a local script) and help me set it up.
connect_prompt_other: Please help me connect usage for provider "{name}" (launcher {id}) to Persona's sidebar usage strip by checking whether its gateway supports a usage source or quota extension.
